title: 台湾50不只散户买：元大投信跑六地，主权产品能加仓吗？
speaker: Julian

segments.en: I think that for Taiwan top 50, as you mentioned, it's a market cap, naturally.
segments.zh: 我认为台湾50指数，正如你所说，自然是一个市值型指数。

segments.en: So we see traditionally when P down, the Q will become up.
segments.zh: 传统上我们看到，当P下降时，Q会上升。

segments.en: So when I just mentioned P times Q equal to V, and when P up and Q will down.
segments.zh: 就像我刚才提到的，P乘以Q等于V，当P上升时，Q会下降。

segments.en: So this is pretty much like a trading driven, but we see Taiwan top 50 in recent years.
segments.zh: 这很像交易驱动，但我们看到近年来台湾50指数

segments.en: The people actually is, I say, one hands the trade through the allots, another hand the trade through the regular saving.
segments.zh: 人们实际上，我说，一手通过配置交易，另一手通过定期储蓄交易。

segments.en: Of course, they also trade for trading. So the structure for the beneficiary of the Taiwan top 50 is quite diversified.
segments.zh: 当然，他们也为了交易而交易。所以台湾50指数的受益者结构相当多元化。

segments.en: So from the AUN perspective, we also see a lot of people join the Taiwan top 50, not just only from the primary market, secondary market, but we also see a lot of traffic come
segments.zh: 所以从AUN的角度来看，我们也看到很多人加入台湾50指数，不仅来自一级市场、二级市场，我们还看到大量流量来自

segments.en: from the local and international, as well as retail and institutional.
segments.zh: 本地和国际，以及零售和机构。

segments.en: So I think that our strategy is not just to maintain the market share here in Taiwan.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们的策略不仅仅是维持台湾的市场份额。

segments.en: We also try to have more footprints and the presence to the regional jurisdictions, including the government funds, pension funds, sovereign funds.
segments.zh: 我们还尝试在区域司法管辖区有更多足迹和存在，包括政府基金、养老基金、主权基金。

segments.en: So we've had a lot of visits to our counterparty, not just Hong Kong Singapore, as well as the Thailand, Malaysia, Korea, and Japan.
segments.zh: 我们拜访了许多交易对手方，不仅在香港、新加坡，还有泰国、马来西亚、韩国和日本。

segments.en: Try to have a more, this kind of balance and well diversified structure of our Taiwan top 50 AUN.
segments.zh: 试图让我们的台湾50 ETF结构更加平衡和多元化。
